title: Redis vs Valkey for a platform team
scope: Redis (Redis Ltd.'s open-source Redis / Redis Open Source) and Valkey (the Linux Foundation fork) as in-memory data stores, as of late 2026, for a platform team choosing between them: licensing, governance and project history, architecture, persistence, clustering and replication, published performance claims, compatibility, and migration. Primary documentation, licence texts and project announcements first. Out of scope: managed-service pricing, client-library comparisons, and vendor enterprise editions beyond what bears on licensing.
